message:
feat(api): Russian documentation + English-first field names

Documentation:
- scripts/lib/docs.cjs holds the page template for both languages; the English
  output is byte-for-byte what the generator produced before, plus a language
  switcher and hreflang links
- /api/v1/docs.ru.html is a full Russian translation, with the endpoint
  summaries, descriptions and parameter explanations translated as well
- the site footer links to both versions

Field names are now English-first:
  name       English name (always)
  nameRu     Russian name, null when identical (41 of 330 items)
  category   English category ('Cub Skins')
  categoryRu Russian category ('Скины на каба')
nameEn and categoryEn are gone - they were redundant.

The search function was updated to the new shape and still finds items by
their Russian name and by the Russian category aliases.
author: BSS Index Developer
